en: How is your personal operating pattern organized?
Why do certain situations repeatedly draw your attention, while others feel draining? Why might the same ability seem useful in one environment but constrained in another?
PHI Configuration offers a structured way to explore these questions.

It organizes structure, drivers, usable capacities, tensions, field, and phase into a configuration model, offering one perspective on personal tendencies, resources, and interactions with changing circumstances.

It is distinct from the Four Pillars of BaZi, the planetary relationships of Astrology, the star and palace structures of Zi Wei, and the framework of Human Design. PHI Configuration retains its own calculation and interpretation rules.

Its outputs describe relationships within a model, not established facts about a person. They can be compared with lived experience to identify what may be worth observing further and what remains uncertain.
zh: PHI OS 原生个人构型体系
一个人如何形成自己的运行方式？
为什么有些事情会不断吸引你，有些环境却让你感到消耗？为什么同样的能力，在某些处境中能够发挥，在另一些处境中却可能受到限制？
PHI 构型尝试从一个整体结构理解这些问题。
它将结构、驱动力、可用能力、内部张力、所处场域与阶段组织成一套构型语言，提供一种重新观察个人倾向、资源与现实互动关系的方式。
它不同于八字的四柱五行、占星的行星宫位、紫微斗数的星曜宫位，也不等同于人类图。PHI 构型具有自己的计算和解释规则，应当作为独立方法阅读。
构型呈现的是模型中的关系，并不是一份已经证实的个人事实清单。你可以将其中的解释与自己的经历对照，看看哪些值得进一步观察，哪些仍然没有足够依据。
